value.description:
Custom field value. 4000 characters max. Should be valid string according to JSON RFC 8259. In particular, following characters must be escaped: quotation mark, reverse solidus, and the control characters (U+0000 through U+001F). Any character may be escaped, but unnecessarily escaped character can be implicitly translated to it's unescaped version.
In addition to RFC 8259 requirements, it is not recommended to use any of control characters in CF value.
Wrike's API forbids using U+0000 in every place and U+0011 at the beginning of the CF value string.
The correct way for setting multiple values in the multiple select Custom fields is ?customFields=[{"id":"CustomFieldId","value":"[\"value1\",\"value2\"]"}]
The correct way for setting values in the people Custom fields is ?customFields=[{"id":"CustomFieldId","value":"UserId1, UserId2"}]
Note that if custom field values are passed to API as URI param of request, they must be URI encoded. Here are some examples:
"%5c" - reverse solidus (backslash)
"%5c%22" - quotation mark
"Vi%5Cu1ec7t" - unicode-escaped character in word "Việt"

In addition to RFC 8259 requirements, it is not recommended to use any of control characters in CF value.
Wrike's API forbids using U+0000 in every place and U+0011 at the beginning of the CF value string.
The correct way for setting multiple values in the multiple select Custom fields is ?customFields=[{"id":"CustomFieldId","value":"[\"value1\",\"value2\"]"}]

Note that if custom field values are passed to API as URI param of request, they must be URI encoded. Here are some examples:

value.description:
Custom field value. 4000 characters max. Should be valid string according to JSON RFC 8259. In particular, following characters must be escaped: quotation mark, reverse solidus, and the control characters (U+0000 through U+001F). Any character may be escaped, but unnecessarily escaped character can be implicitly translated to it's unescaped version.
In addition to RFC 8259 requirements, it is not recommended to use any of control characters in CF value.
Wrike's API forbids using U+0000 in every place and U+0011 at the beginning of the CF value string.
The correct way for setting multiple values in the multiple select Custom fields is ?customFields=[{"id":"CustomFieldId","value":"[\"value1\",\"value2\"]"}]
The correct way for setting values in the people Custom fields is ?customFields=[{"id":"CustomFieldId","value":"UserId1, UserId2"}]
Note that if custom field values are passed to API as URI param of request, they must be URI encoded. Here are some examples:
"%5c" - reverse solidus (backslash)
"%5c%22" - quotation mark
"Vi%5Cu1ec7t" - unicode-escaped character in word "Việt"
